birth_profiles_exact_time_check.name: birth_profiles_exact_time_check
birth_profiles_exact_time_check.value: "birth_profiles"."birth_time_accuracy" <> 'exact' or ("birth_profiles"."reported_birth_time" is not null and "birth_profiles"."reported_birth_time" = "birth_profiles"."calculation_birth_time" and "birth_profiles"."calculation_time_is_fallback" = false)

clients_user_email_idx.name: clients_user_email_idx
clients_user_email_idx.where: "clients"."email" is not null and "clients"."deleted_at" is null

clients_user_external_reference_unique.name: clients_user_external_reference_unique
clients_user_external_reference_unique.where: "clients"."external_reference" is not null and "clients"."deleted_at" is null

clients_preferred_contact_value_check.name: clients_preferred_contact_value_check
clients_preferred_contact_value_check.value: "clients"."preferred_contact_method" is null or "clients"."preferred_contact_method" = 'none' or ("clients"."preferred_contact_method" = 'email' and "clients"."email" is not null) or ("clients"."preferred_contact_method" in ('phone', 'sms', 'whatsapp') and "clients"."phone_e164" is not null)

generated_artifacts_target_window_check.name: generated_artifacts_target_window_check
generated_artifacts_target_window_check.value: "generated_artifacts"."target_end" is null or "generated_artifacts"."target_start" is null or "generated_artifacts"."target_end" >= "generated_artifacts"."target_start"

generated_artifacts_token_check.name: generated_artifacts_token_check
generated_artifacts_token_check.value: ("generated_artifacts"."input_tokens" is null or "generated_artifacts"."input_tokens" >= 0) and ("generated_artifacts"."output_tokens" is null or "generated_artifacts"."output_tokens" >= 0)
